settledLayoutChecks: Previous settled-layout checks remain scoped evidence only; they do not establish usability.
userFeedback: Unusable: feedback cannot keep up with typing; text crosses neighboring columns.

reproduction.scenario: 60 Thai characters at 35 ms gaps, measured during input before waiting for layout

cause: Trailing debounce restarts on every edit, so continuous typing prevents layout submission.
Absolute nowrap line fragments retain stale geometry and allow text to overflow into neighboring cells.
Revision rejection protects data but cannot provide immediate layout feedback.
acceptance: Not usable as a paper editor. Continuous input, live wrapping, row movement and caret visibility must pass before another readiness claim.
runtimeChanges: None; preserve the user current browser and unsaved editing session.

followUp.note: New local WASM candidate passes bounded live-input checks; previous candidate failure is retained and user re-review is pending.
